subject: .Net Developer with Angular (Healthcare) – Chicago, IL hybrid – Aaron Ramirez (C2C)
body:
Hi Sony,

I saw your post for the .Net Developer with Angular (Healthcare) role in Chicago (hybrid) and would like to be considered. My two-page resume is attached.

- 10+ years of full stack engineering for Walmart Global Tech, IBM/AEP and HCSC (HIPAA-governed healthcare member platform, 1M+ members): Angular (TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx) front ends on C# / .NET Web APIs and Python services with SQL Server / PostgreSQL, Azure cloud-native delivery, CI/CD and automated unit / integration / end-to-end testing.
- Agentic AI applications in production during 2025–2026: LLM integration (Claude API, Azure OpenAI) with tool calling, structured outputs, multi-step LangGraph workflows and RAG, plus evaluation pipelines (test datasets, scoring criteria, regression checks and human review) that gated releases; daily use of Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot as agentic IDEs. Secure API design (OAuth 2.0 / JWT), observability and reliable async processing. Chicago hybrid works for me, and I can start immediately.
- Work authorization: TN (Mexican national), on C2C through my employer. Available immediately.

Happy to discuss the rate and next steps.

Best regards,
Aaron David Ramírez Lezama
